name: AllAble Connector
author: flexyma

sections.description:
AllAble is a Marketing AI Workspace — an AI agent that researches keywords against live data, writes SEO-optimised content, generates on-brand images, and publishes directly to your real marketing accounts. WordPress is one of the channels it connects to.

AllAble Connector is the official plugin that links your WordPress site to AllAble. Once connected, the AllAble agent can manage complex content workflows on your site — publishing posts, updating SEO, handling WooCommerce products — all from a single conversation in your AllAble workspace.

What AllAble can do on your WordPress site

  • Write and publish SEO-optimised posts and pages, backed by real keyword research
  • Update SEO titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords across Rank Math, SEOPress, or Yoast
  • Manage WooCommerce products, orders, and customers
  • Manage The Events Calendar events, venues, and organizers
  • Publish multilingual content across multiple languages and markets

You stay in control

AllAble gives you two modes. In ASK mode the agent proposes what it is about to do and waits for your approval before making any changes. In EXECUTE mode it works autonomously and delivers the finished result. You choose how much you hand off — and you can disconnect at any time.

Supported WordPress plugins

  • SEO: Rank Math, SEOPress, Yoast SEO
  • E-commerce: WooCommerce (HPOS-compatible)
  • Events: The Events Calendar

WooCommerce and Events Calendar features are opt-in — enable the ones you want from the Abilities tab after connecting.

How to connect

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open AllAble in your WordPress admin menu.
  3. Click Connect to AllAble and follow the prompt.

No API keys to copy, no config files to edit. The plugin sets up a secure connection automatically. A dedicated AllAble admin page shows the connection status and lets you disconnect with one click at any time.

Important: back up your site and use with caution

Because AllAble can create, update, and delete content on your site, please use it with care. Always keep a current backup of your site and database before making changes — most hosting providers offer automated backups, or you can use a dedicated backup plugin. AI tools can make mistakes, and a backup is your safety net if something does not go as expected. We are not responsible for any data loss or unintended changes resulting from the use of this plugin.

Privacy

AllAble only accesses your site when you ask it to. Nothing is sent in the background — no tracking, no analytics.

AllAble Connector is developed and maintained by Flexyma.

External services

This plugin connects to the AllAble platform (operated by Flexyma). It is the official connector for that platform, so connecting your site to AllAble is the plugin’s core purpose. The service it contacts is described below, including what data is sent and when.

AllAble platform (www.allable.ai / studio.allable.ai)

When you click Connect to AllAble, the plugin sends your browser to https://studio.allable.ai/plugins/wp/connect-from-wp to authorise the connection. Connecting creates a dedicated WordPress Application Password for AllAble. After that, your AllAble workspace makes authenticated requests to your site’s REST API to read and write the data you ask it to manage (for example post and page content, SEO metadata, and site information). Data leaves your site to AllAble only in response to such an authenticated, user-initiated request — nothing is sent in the background.

This service is required for the plugin to function. By connecting you agree to AllAble’s terms and privacy/GDPR policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://www.allable.ai/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy & GDPR policy: https://www.allable.ai/gdpr/
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “AllAble Connector”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open AllAble in the admin menu and click Connect to AllAble.

You can also install manually by uploading the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.9 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
What is AllAble?

AllAble is a Marketing AI Workspace — an AI agent for marketers and agencies that researches keywords against live data, writes SEO-optimised content, generates images, and publishes to your connected accounts. Sign up at www.allable.ai.

Do I need an AllAble account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the AllAble platform, so an active AllAble account is required.

Will it make changes without my permission?

Only if you want it to. AllAble has two modes: ASK mode proposes each action and waits for your approval before doing anything; EXECUTE mode works autonomously and delivers the finished result. You choose the mode per task.

Is it safe to install on a live site?

Yes. The plugin is built so that any problem with the plugin itself never takes your site down — it quietly deactivates instead. Every release is tested against multiple PHP and WordPress versions before publishing.

That said, because AllAble can write to your content, always keep a current backup before using it to make changes. Most hosting providers include automated backups, or you can use a dedicated backup plugin.

Does it work with Rank Math, SEOPress, and Yoast?

Yes. AllAble can read and update SEO titles, descriptions, and focus keywords on whichever of these plugins you already use.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. AllAble can manage products, orders, and customers. WooCommerce features are turned off by default — enable them on the Abilities tab after connecting.

Does it work with The Events Calendar?

Yes. AllAble can manage events, venues, and organizers. Enable these on the Abilities tab after connecting.

Does it work on multisite?

Yes. Activate the plugin on each site individually.

How do I disconnect?

Go to AllAble in your WordPress admin and click Disconnect. The plugin removes its access and deactivates itself.

Where do I get support?

Email dev@flexyma.com.
